pages.text: New $(l:world/collapsed_mines)mine supply chests$() contain one Torn Kingdom Map Fragment. New workshops, depots, and archives may also hold one. Filled chests keep their contents. Three fragments can come from any combination of sites.

Use the unbound map in The Slimic. It remembers a nearby valid $(l:world/fallen_sanctum)Fallen Sanctum$(). Search does not load chunks. If no traces are found, keep the map and try elsewhere. Already-bound maps retain the same destination through travel and server restarts.

The native map marker gives an approximate center, and the player arrow shows your relative bearing. Outside The Slimic, use its dimension reminder. A bound map plus blank maps copies its destination. Entry never requires a map, and copies cannot reset site rewards.
